text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Whoa-oof!! If we're invitin' the young 
lady, does it gotta be tea!?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
I'm telling you, I got totally turned 
down! What was it, "Tasty Chicken Meatball 
Island"?! I couldn't get them hyped at 
aaall!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Buuut y'know... I wanna go on a date with 
the lady! I wanna get hyped, and I wanna 
hype her up. Like, seriously, for 
reaaal...!!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... alriiiight, I won't lose!! 
Ojou-Approved Lovely Tea, could that be a 
thing!? Time for a strategy meeting!
